# axm docs disable

Disable a docs package without removing sync-once targets

## When to use

Disable a docs package without removing sync-once targets

## Usage

```bash
axm docs disable [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description              |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the docs package |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Disable in project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Disable without confirmation                                                      |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Disable even if retained dependencies exist                                       |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would change without disabling                                          |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Disable a docs package**

```bash
axm docs disable workspace-baseline
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
